newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf basis values for corn, soybeans and wheat were mostly steady on Friday in subdued activity, dealers said.

But export sales mostly to the Far East improved this week, sources noted. South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No 1 soybean at $338.27 per tonne, C and F. Daewoo International (America) Corp won the contract with shipment for September 26-October 15 if from the U.S. Gulf or October 11-30 if from the Pacific Northwest with arrival set for Inchon by November 20.
Also, A Philippine flour mill bought 25,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for prompt delivery and Taiwan's Members Feed Industry bought 56,000 tonnes of U.S. no. 2 corn for October shipment.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
